title: Bring your SceneKit project to RealityKit
description: Understand SceneKit deprecation and explore how to transition your 3D projects to RealityKit, Apple’s recommended high-level 3D engine. We’ll clarify what SceneKit deprecation means for your projects, compare key concepts between the two engines, and show you how to port a sample SceneKit game to RealityKit. We’ll also explore the potential of RealityKit across all supported platforms to help you create amazing 3D experiences with your apps and games.
